ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of S$4.95 to the rider (voucher refund per NS-7) as partial refund of the metered distance overcharge for the non-exempted detour segment; no account action against the driver (no prior upheld route dispute).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route excursion from the quoted PRD point ~1.3356/103.9397 (22:14) north to ~1.3414/103.9186 (~2.9 km off-route) before rejoining the destination: extra_km ≈ 3.5 km. No pre-departure passenger agreement (RD-5 fails), no named stop/destination change (RD-3 fails). Driver's accident claim fails RD-4(a) because the LTA Accident is on the KPE leg (~km 72–78 of the route), not on the substituted PIE portion (~km 85) where the deviation occurred — ~5 km away, so the traffic fact does not justify this segment; RD-4(b) single band evidence cannot exempt. → non-exempt under RD-1, refunded under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims the extra distance was unavoidable due to the KPE accident, but the recorded LTA incident sits on the KPE leg of the quoted optimal route while the deviating segment occurred on the PIE leg roughly 5 km away; per RD-4(a) traffic justification must target the substituted portion of the optimal route, so the claim fails for this segment.
